entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Look, beyond the bridge...[n]It's so noisy and congested.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So that's the kind of place[n]we spend all our time in.
Do you not like city life?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, I'm not sure... I was born[n]and raised in Tokyo, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sorry, that's not a very[n]good answer to your question.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes... We're quite far from[n]our day-to-day lives here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, it's nice to take a break[n]from time to time. I've actually[n]always wanted to come here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, a thought just crossed my[n]mind... Please don't laugh, okay?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... I used to live[n]such a boring life.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But it may have been because[n]of that life that I met the[n]Phantom Thieves to begin with...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And so, I keep coming back to[n]the realization that your world[n]changes depending on your actions.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You were the one who[n]taught me that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...This ended up being a pretty[n]serious conversation. Well, let's[n]head home. It's getting chilly.

entries.en: I hope someday I have a boyfriend[n]who takes me across this bridge...
